title: Gearshift
description: This Is a Faction Based Create Server For Neoforge 1.21.1 with Aeronautics and Other Addons
body:
A Create Aeronautics Server For 1.21.1 Neoforge

ABOUT-
This Server is about The endless Possiblities of Create Going far and beyond adding As many create Addons as we can cram in a Less than 150 Mod modpack, This Allows Great creations and abling people to build Crazy Contraptions! This Modpack Is Designed for the Gearshift Minecraft Server The Discord in linked with the pack.


Included Mods:
Create Aeronautics Made by ryanhcode (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-aeronautics)

(The Second Core of the mod to allow people to make physics based contraptions e.g planes)

Vista made by MehVahdJukaar (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/vista)

(Allowing Security Cameras and Diffrent POVs


Create made by simibubi (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create)

(The main Core of the Pack)
Create radars made by CeoOfGoogle1 (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-radars)

(Protect your builds by Scanning enemies)

Create Big Cannons made by rbasamoyai (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-big-cannons)


(Weaponise Your Contrapitions)

Distant horizions made by James_Seibel (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/distant-horizons)


(For Amazing Views)

And So many more Mods, 131 More to be exact


Disclaimer: All The Mods are not owned by me i Geniunley think you should show some love to the Mod creators They did very well to make these, I own no credit to the mods, i am just using them for an Experience
